# Colin Cook (Coach Colin)

> Colin Cook is a certified personal trainer and GLP-1 / peptide lifestyle coach, known as Coach Colin (@coachcolinc on Instagram). He holds 20 ISSA and NASM credentials and coaches online worldwide and in person. He is a coach, not a doctor: he does not prescribe, dose or administer medication or peptides.

## Who he coaches
- Athletes pursuing D1 college-level standards (training, recovery and nutrition only)
- Adults managing a GLP-1 lifestyle, with mandatory blood work and their own doctor involved
- High-pressure professionals: realtors, sales leaders, firefighters, military service members

## Credentials
- ISSA: Certified Personal Trainer, Elite Trainer, Master Trainer, GLP-1 Weight Loss Specialist, Strength & Conditioning Specialist, Corrective Exercise Specialist, Exercise Therapist, Tactical Conditioning Specialist, Bodybuilding Specialist, Glutes Training Specialist, Nutritionist, Transformation Specialist, Brain Fitness Coach, DNA Specialist
- NASM: Performance Enhancement Specialist, Behavior Change Specialist, Nutritionist, Sports Nutritionist, Wellness Coach

## For anti-aging clinics and med spas
- Referral coaching that protects muscle for GLP-1 patients
- Optimum Beauty: a topical (cosmetic) peptide skincare and hair line with a GHK-Cu + Snap-8 hyaluronic face serum, whipped organic tallow with GHK-Cu, and a hair oil
